text:
maria: Heads-up: exec wants a clear MVP cut by tomorrow morning to avoid scope creep. We have three customer asks in the queue: SSA integration (large), tenant usage export (medium), and realtime dashboards (medium). I propose we prioritize core chat + embeddings + a gated SSO-integration stub. Defer dashboards and tenant-export to v1. Thoughts?

devon: I support the gated SSO stub approach. SSA full integration will need legal + infra time; not safe for MVP.

anya: Agree. I'll define the gate criteria (pilot whitelist, telemetry requirements, contact plan) so sales knows who gets early SSO.

sam: If dashboards go to v1 we should hide nav entries and add an empty-state with a product roadmap CTA. I can ship the UI placeholder and copy in two days.

rafael: From perf: suggest locking model to 13B quantized for predictable p99s. Also recommend disabling nightly large-batch eval jobs for the MVP pipeline to reduce infra costs.

lin: Quick note from sales: tenant-export is important for two pilots. If we mark it v1, please document a timeline so we don't overpromise.

maria: Good point. We'll create a one-pager with expected v1 ETA window. Launch criteria I want on the table: p99 chat latency <750ms, telemetry events for errors/latency/token-usage, canary with 3 tenants, documented rollback steps, and no open P0 security items.

devon: I'll produce a one-page deps+risks matrix (owners, ETA, effort S/M/L) and flag any infra/security items. Posting by 18:00 today.

anya: I'll own the feature-flag plan and the pilot onboarding checklist.

sam: I'll deliver the nav hide + empty-state microcopy and screenshots by EOD tomorrow.

rafael: Perf runs in progress; sharing numbers in #eng-ml later today. Note: quantized model may slightly shift generation characteristics; include in release notes.

ops-bot: Reminder: "MVP cut lock" meeting tomorrow 09:30 in #all-hands.

maria: Summary actions: devon (deps/risk), anya (flag + pilot checklist), sam (UI placeholder), rafael (perf). We'll lock the final MVP list in the 09:30 sync. If anyone objects to deferring dashboards, raise now.

lin: No objections as long as we give a v1 ETA to pilots.

maria: Consensus. Creating decision doc and milestone ticket after the sync. See you tomorrow.
